description: AllTrails Peak launched at 79.99 USD/year above the existing Plus tier (35.99 USD/year); Peak-only features include custom routes, detailed trail conditions, and community heatmaps; Outdoor Lens added later in summer.
notes: Official AllTrails press release dated 2025-05-12 (also at https://www.alltrails.com/press/alltrails-expands-membership-offering-with-alltrails-peak). Early access within weeks and global availability by June 2025 (phased rollout); price and Peak-only features corroborated by https://fieldmag.com/articles/alltrails-peak-hiking-app-review. A third-party pricing site claims a 2024 launch and conflicts with all editorial and official sources.

description: Garmin Connect+ premium plan announced at 6.99 USD/month or 69.99 USD/year with a 30-day trial: Active Intelligence insights, Performance Dashboard, Live Activity, training guidance, expanded LiveTrack, badge challenges. Garmin states all existing Connect features remain free.
notes: First time Garmin charged for app features; independent walkthrough at https://dcrainmaker.com/2025/03/garmin-connect-plus-subscription-walkthrough.html (published 2025-03-27). Garmin said on its Q1 2025 earnings call that more features will move into Connect+ (reported 2025-05-08: https://www.forbes.com/sites/andrewwilliams/2025/05/08/more-future-garmin-watch-features-will-be-locked-behind-the-connect-paywall/). Backlash coverage: https://www.ghacks.net/2025/03/31/garmins-new-subscription-service-sparks-backlash-from-users/.

description: Strava ended individual Summit packs (Safety, Training, Analysis; 2.99 USD/month each) and moved subscribers to a single full Summit membership (4.99 to 7.99 USD/month by payment method). Single-pack users keep full access until 2020-07-15, then must pay the full rate or move to the free plan.
notes: Date is the publication date of the report; the change began about two weeks earlier. Falls two months before the 2020-05-18 gating event, so the two windows overlap and cannot be separated cleanly.

description: Full segment leaderboards (and filters), segment effort analysis and comparison, matched runs, and the web route builder moved to subscribers only; free users keep the top-10 leaderboard view. Segment leaderboard API endpoint removed for all third-party apps.
notes: Effective immediately on the publication date; API changes live 10 AM Pacific. Strava also consolidated its tiered plans into a single subscription.

description: Reports of Strava subscription price increases surfaced (UK monthly 6.99 to 8.99 GBP; US new-subscriber pricing about 79 USD/year and 12.99 USD/month per the source's own test). Strava published no price list and said changes vary by region and platform.
notes: Date is first public reporting, not a Strava announcement; rollout was staggered (UK reportedly earlier in late 2022) and users were notified individually before renewal. Renewal prices applied to renewals on or after 2023-02-02; subscribers who joined after 2022-11-23 reportedly exempt for now. Strava later apologized for the lack of transparency; exact apology date not yet verified.

description: Athlete Intelligence (AI-generated workout summaries and insights) launched in public beta for subscribers only; not a removal of a free feature.
notes: Also reported by https://runningmagazine.ca/the-scene/strava-launches-ai-powered-guidance-feature-for-athletes/. Candidate only: new paid feature, not a gating of an existing one. Reports say the opt-out was later removed (around July to August 2026); not recorded as a row because the exact date is unsourced.

description: Revised API terms limited third-party apps to showing a user's data only to that user and barred use of API data in AI models. Strava said fewer than 0.1% of apps would be affected.
notes: Candidate only: a developer-terms change rather than a price or paywall event; likely drop at the feasibility stage. Effective date is from a single source and Strava's clarification is dated 2024-11-20 (https://the5krunner.com/2024/11/20/strava-issues-clarification/). Overlaps the 2024-10-03 row.

description: Surfline introduced Premium+ as its highest tier, adding AI Smart Cam features (Wave Timeline, Wave Distribution, Crowd, Smart Clips) at select US spots for web and iOS.
notes: Date from a syndicated press release (a single source; the Surfline-hosted original was not retrievable). Launch price not confirmed; Premium+ lists at 149.99 USD/year in 2026 per third-party trackers.

description: Surfline Premium (US) annual price raised from 99 USD to 119.99 USD (about 21%); new Premium with Ads tier at 69.99 USD/year; Premium+ at 149.99 USD/year now shareable with two other accounts.
notes: Effective date per Surfline support article (last updated 2025-05-05); members were emailed shortly before their renewal, so exposure dates vary by user. Wayback copy: http://web.archive.org/web/20260623223550/https://support.surfline.com/hc/en-us/articles/35208905809051-US-Price-Tier-Updates. Prior increase was July 2018 (95.88 USD for new subscribers, existing 69.99 USD rate grandfathered one year), outside the likely review window and not recorded as a row because the exact day is unsourced.
